canonical.question: What hotel deposit-card disclosure rule and hotel-deposit release timing does the Airbnb hotel fees and deposits guidance give?
canonical.expected_primary: Hotels may ask for a credit card at check-in to cover the cost of incidentals or a security deposit as part of their standard procedures, but this must be disclosed in the listing or in the listing’s price breakdown at checkout.
canonical.expected_secondary: The deposit, minus any charges under the hotel’s policy, is usually released upon checkout or shortly after checkout.
canonical.tampered_primary: Hotels may demand an undisclosed cash deposit before showing any booking details.
